summaryVi: It is said / believed / reported + that … hoặc S + is said to + V — truyền thông / đồn đại không nêu nguồn cụ thể.

example.en: It is said that the temple is over 500 years old.
example.vi: Người ta nói ngôi chùa hơn 500 tuổi.

rows.pattern: S + is/was + said/reported + to + V / to have + V3

example.en: He is believed to have left the country.
example.vi: Người ta tin là anh ấy đã rời nước.

sections.textVi: Dùng khi không cần (hoặc không biết) ai nói — thường thấy trên báo, tin tức.

exercises.prompt: It ___ that the company will lay off staff.
The artist ___ to be living abroad.
It is believed ___ the two leaders will meet soon.

exercises.instructionVi: Viết dạng It is said that
exercises.source: People say the food here is excellent.
exercises.answer: It is said that the food here is excellent.

exercises.instructionVi: Viết dạng S is believed to
exercises.source: People believe she wrote the novel in 1998.
exercises.answer: She is believed to have written the novel in 1998.

exercises.promptVi: Người ta đồn rằng giá nhà sẽ tăng.
exercises.answer: It is rumoured that house prices will rise.

exercises.prompt: The suspect ___ to have escaped through the window.
It was reported ___ several people were injured.

exercises.source: People reported that traffic was heavy.
exercises.answer: It was reported that traffic was heavy.

exercises.promptVi: Anh ấy được cho là đã thắng cuộc thi.
exercises.answer: He is said to have won the competition.

exercises.sentence: She [is believed that she knows] the answer.
exercises.explanationVi: She is believed to know the answer.
